description: TREC 20-19 e-sign initial/signature widget positions. REPLACES trec-20-18-esign-coords.json (20-18 was superseded 2026-07-01). Extracted 2026-08-31 DIRECTLY from the real AcroForm widget rects in .tmp/ridgebluff-offer/blank-20-19.pdf via pdf-lib (getRectangle() per widget, resolved to its owning page by walking each page /Annots array) -- NOT adapted/copied from the 20-18 map. The 20-19 footer initial line ("Initialed for identification by Buyer___ and Seller___") happens to sit at nearly the same coordinates as 20-18's equivalent line -- that is a real property of the form (TREC kept this boilerplate footer unchanged across the revision), confirmed independently via pdftotext -bbox-layout text-run extraction, not an assumption carried over from the old file. 2026-09-08 CARTER: page 12 REMOVED from every initials array (was present in the 2026-08-31 extraction). Page 12 (Option Fee / Earnest Money / Contract Receipt -- completed by the escrow agent) does NOT print an initial line: its content stream contains the 'Initialed for identification' text run at the same x/y as pages 1-9, but the run is never painted (invisible text) -- verified by rendering the page (pdftoppm 200dpi crop of the footer band shows only 'TREC NO. 20-19') and confirmed on the live DocuSeal signing page by Quinn's 2026-09 QA pass. pdftotext sees the run and reports a false positive; only a render shows the truth. Do not re-add page 12 from text extraction alone -- render and look.
method: pdf-lib AcroForm widget rects for pages 1-9 (4 widgets/page in the y=[12,45pt] bottom-origin footer band, left-to-right = buyer1,buyer2,seller1,seller2) and page 10 (4 signature widgets, upper pair=Buyer1/Seller1, lower pair=Buyer2/Seller2, matched to printed "Buyer"/"Seller" captions via pdftotext -bbox-layout). Page 12 has NO AcroForm widget AND no painted initial line (see description -- its 'Initialed for identification' text run exists in the content stream but is invisible when rendered), so it carries no widgets here. Page 11 (Broker Contact Information, 'Print name(s) only. Do not sign.') also carries none. Coordinates converted from pdf-lib bottom-origin points to DocuSeal areas[] top-origin fractions: x=rectX/612, y=(792-rectY-rectH)/792, w=rectW/612, h=rectH/792. DocuSeal areas[].page is 1-indexed on submission (empirically verified 2026-08-31: a field created with areas[].page=2 rendered on the physical 2nd page of a 4-page probe document, confirmed via Playwright screenshot of the real signing page + DOM page-container offsets -- see api/esign-create.js comment near loadResale2019Coords for the full probe writeup). page values below are literal 1-based PDF page numbers.
